title: Add Hermes adapter MVP

context.summary: Create the Hermes adapter package boundary that maps Hermes lifecycle events to Mindory HTTP API calls.
context.background: TASK-12 added an HTTP-backed CLI. TASK-13 adds the MVP deep runtime adapter, preserving external identity mappings while keeping the API as source of truth.

in: Add @mindory/adapter-hermes exports for adapter, HTTP client, identity mapping and optional tools.
Map Hermes user, session and agent identities to stable Mindory project, peer and session ids.
Implement user/assistant turn saving through session message HTTP paths.
Implement attachment upload through multipart /v1/documents calls.
Expose optional memor_recall, memor_remember, memor_document_search, memor_document_read and memor_explain tools.
Add Hermes API URL/token/context configuration to config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
Add Hermes validation to repository checks.
Update Hermes, architecture, API, configuration and README docs.
out: Install or import a real Hermes SDK/runtime.
Implement API endpoints that are still future tasks.
Add direct database, queue, vector or storage access from the adapter.
Implement a daemon process or Docker runtime for Hermes.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/adapter-hermes exports an adapter builder, HTTP client, identity mapper and optional tools.
Hermes identity mapping preserves external user, session and agent identities as stable Mindory ids.
Adapter preparePromptContext calls /v1/context/build and returns prompt-ready context text.
Adapter saveTurn persists user and assistant messages through HTTP API paths.
Adapter uploadAttachments sends multipart document uploads.
Optional memor_* tools call memory and document HTTP API paths.
Hermes config includes API URL, optional API token and context token budget in config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
Documentation describes the current Hermes boundary.
No Hermes SDK dependency, direct persistence access, daemon runtime, MCP or CLI behavior is implemented.

commands: ls apps/adapters/hermes/src/adapter.ts apps/adapters/hermes/src/http-client.ts apps/adapters/hermes/src/identity.ts apps/adapters/hermes/src/tools.ts scripts/validate-hermes-adapter.js
manual_checks: Confirm Hermes code calls HTTP paths and does not import @mindory/db or Drizzle.
Confirm external user/session/agent ids are mapped to stable Mindory ids.
Confirm no Hermes SDK/runtime, MCP or CLI behavior was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
Several Hermes adapter calls target planned HTTP endpoints that are not implemented by the API skeleton yet.
The adapter is runtime-agnostic and does not import a real Hermes SDK in this task.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
